## 构建

根目录 `CMakeLists.txt` 是顶层构建脚本（`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)`，`project(lingmo-grub-config)`）。

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```
